_note: Invented example: a two-lawyer firm in Istanbul running agents for due-diligence (DD) reports and legal opinions, with some EU clients. Vendor details are plausible placeholders, NOT checked facts about these vendors: confirm each against the vendor's current terms.

system.name: Örnek Hukuk agent harness
system.description: Three agents help two lawyers prepare due-diligence (DD) reports and legal opinions. An intake agent sorts the client's documents and checks conflicts. A screening agent looks up the target company and its officers and shareholders in Turkish public sources (MASAK asset-freeze lists, ilan.gov.tr, Türkiye Ticaret Sicili Gazetesi) and returns the exact records with links. A drafting agent writes report and opinion drafts with a cloud language model. Documents are masked on the lawyer's computer (Katip Kalkan) before any text goes to a cloud model. A lawyer reviews every output before it goes to the client.

activities.name: Client intake and conflict check
activities.purpose: Take on the client, identify the matter, check conflicts of interest
activities.retention_reason: Turkish limitation periods: TBK m.146 (10 years) or m.147/5 (5 years for mandate claims); reviewer to choose
activities.name_tr: Müvekkil kabulü ve çıkar çatışması kontrolü

activities.legitimate_interest: Taking on the client and avoiding conflicts of interest; for individual clients the contract (6(1)(b)) also applies

activities.name: DD screening of target companies and their people
activities.purpose: Find public records (sanctions lists, insolvency and court notices, trade registry gazette) about the target company and the individuals behind it, for the client's DD report
activities.source_detail: MASAK lists, ilan.gov.tr, Türkiye Ticaret Sicili Gazetesi
activities.legitimate_interest: The client's interest in knowing who it is dealing with before a transaction; limited to people with a control or signing role
activities.retention: Until the DD report is delivered + 2 years, then only the report
activities.name_tr: DD için şirket ve kişilerin taranması

activities.retention_tr: DD raporu teslim edildikten sonra 2 yıl, ardından yalnızca rapor
activities.source_detail_tr: MASAK listeleri, ilan.gov.tr, Türkiye Ticaret Sicili Gazetesi

activities.name: Drafting DD reports and legal opinions
activities.purpose: Draft reports and opinions from the client's documents and the screening results
activities.legitimate_interest: Providing the legal service the client engaged us for, which requires reading the documents it sends
activities.name_tr: DD raporu ve hukuki görüş taslağı
activities.purpose_tr: Müvekkilin belgeleri ve tarama sonuçlarından rapor ve görüş taslağı hazırlamak

activities.name: Running and securing the system
